about: The floor under the tests (tools/check-floor.mjs) and the size limit on the game's code (tools/check-game.mjs). Safeguards 1 and 7, the founder's yes of 2026-10-17. Raise a floor when checks are added; lower one only in a pull request that says so on a line starting 'Checks weakened:', approved by the founder. A file listed under 'grown' was past the limit when the limit came in: it may shrink, never grow, until it is split.
